messages:
harry: quick alignment thread for the next release announcement  we need one canonical changelog + final docs permalink + confirmed rollout times so marketing can schedule posts and webinar CTAs.
nina: plan is 2026-08-18 16:00 UTC canary, 16:25 full. webinar at 17:00 UTC. docs link must be final by 15:40 so slides/CTAs are locked.
liam: infra ok for that window. will run canary smoke at T+0 and +5m.
ashley: docs preview is available at https://docs.redwood.ai/release/preview/2-8-2. I'll publish stable permalink once liam confirms artifact name.
liam: artifact is rwd-infer-2.8.2-release. changelog snippet for the announcement header - please use exactly:```
RWD-Infer v2.8.2 (2026-08-18)
- Hybrid batching improvements that lower median latency for mixed workloads
- New INT4 quantization path for A10x (experimental, beta)
- Faster KV warmup and reduced cold-start CPU overhead
- Several stream-resume and reliability fixes
```
harry: good. marketing wants a consumer-friendly rollback line to show reliability posture. keep it short.
liam: publish: "If regressions are detected, we rollback to rwd-infer-2.8.1 with automated traffic cutover (minutes)." ops will validate.
deploy-bot: Canary channel created: #deploy-1950000001-canary  will post hooks and health summaries.
ashley: when you confirm the permalink I'll pin it in the announcement and the webinar slides. temporary CTA link: https://events.redwood.ai/webinar/aug18-release-preview
integrations-bot: for inbound lead routing, set webhook fields: campaign=aug18-release, source=webinar-cta, tag=release-aug18. routing: SDR-F. I'll post the mapping to #integrations.
harry: marketing benchmark blurb proposal: "up to 20% median latency improvement on mixed workloads." eng tweak?
liam: qualifier: "up to 20% reduction in median latency on our mixed short/long sequence benchmark." use the qualifier.
harry: final checklist:
- liam: confirm deploy window (done)
- ashley: publish permalink (pending)
- integrations-bot: webhook mapping (done)
- deploy-bot/ops: run canary probes at t+0 and t+5m (pending)
- harry: post announcement T-10m and webinar CTA T-5m

liam: I'll post a T-30 and T-5 note to the canary channel and standby for immediate rollback if smoke fails.
harry: scheduling 15:30 UTC preflight call for last checks. thanks everyone ":thumbsup:"
